recent_posts.title: Valve to restock Steam Controller after it sells out in a day
recent_posts.summary: Valve's newly released Steam Controller sold out in under an hour after launch, with the company confirming it ran out faster than anticipated. Valve says it is working on a restock and will provide a timeline update soon. Scalpers have already listed the $100 controller on eBay for up to $400.

recent_posts.title: Meet the indie studios funding other indie studios
recent_posts.summary: Successful indie game studios are launching their own funding initiatives to support other indie developers at a time when overall game industry investment has dropped dramatically. Innersloth (Among Us) created Outersloth in 2024, investing nearly $20 million across 24 games with transparent contract terms (50% revenue share pre-recoup, 15% after). Landfall (Peak) launched Evil Landfall, investing up to $1 million in a few games per year. Kinetic Games (Phasmophobia) started a publishing label supporting two to three games annually. These peer-funded initiatives are filling a gap left by the collapse of traditional game investment, which fell from $12 billion in 2021 to $2.4 billion in 2024.

recent_posts.title: We tested the Steam Controller
recent_posts.summary: The Game Developer Podcast team shares their hands-on impressions of Valve's new Steam Controller, a piece of hardware sent to them directly by Valve for early testing. The episode covers the device's physical design details — including the Steam Puck, trackpads, and button layout — and discusses what Valve's new hardware push means for game developers and which audiences are likely to adopt it.

recent_posts.title: Report: VR studio Survios has laid off the bulk of its dev team
recent_posts.summary: VR-focused game studio Survios has laid off the majority of its development team, with multiple employees confirming the cuts on LinkedIn. Founded in 2013, the studio was known for licensed titles like Alien: Rogue Incursion and Creed: Rise to Glory. One employee described the studio as being "essentially shuttered." Survios had been attempting to expand beyond VR into console and PC platforms, releasing an 'Evolved Edition' of Alien: Rogue Incursion on Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 last year.

recent_posts.title: GameMaker leans into AI coding and Sony clarifies DRM confusion
recent_posts.summary: A weekly game industry news roundup covering several notable stories: GameMaker adding Claude Code support for AI-assisted development workflows, GitHub Copilot switching to usage-based billing due to sustainability concerns, Sony clarifying its PlayStation DRM update won't require monthly online check-ins, Ustwo CEO's controversial comments about job security being a 'romantic' notion, Xbox hardware revenue falling 33% year-over-year despite record monthly active users, and Parisian studio Spiders confirming closure after parent company Nacon's insolvency.

recent_posts.title: Rebellion's Atomfall is being turned into a TV series
recent_posts.summary: Rebellion has announced a co-production with Two Brothers Pictures to adapt its post-apocalyptic survival-action game Atomfall into a TV series. The UK-led production will expand on the game's mythology, inspired by the 1957 Windscale nuclear disaster, while staying true to its tone and British roots. Harry and Jack Williams will serve as writers and executive producers alongside Rebellion's co-founders Jason and Chris Kingsley CBE. Atomfall has reached over 3.7 million players since its March 2025 launch. The announcement reflects a broader industry trend of game studios pursuing transmedia adaptations, with projects like Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Call of Duty, Pacific Drive, and Phasmophobia also in development.

recent_posts.title: Enduring advice for all game producers: Unlocking the Vault 2.0
recent_posts.summary: A revisit of Ruth Tomandl's GDC 2013 talk 'Production 101', featuring CD Projekt Red senior technical producer Shayna Moon reflecting on how the talk shaped her career. Moon discusses what still holds up — like the importance of being someone people feel safe delivering bad news to, and gaining applicable experience outside the industry — and what has changed, including the decline of QA-to-production career pipelines and the unpredictable nature of job security in today's games industry. She also shares a personal story about the cost of making assumptions as a producer during God of War audio production.

recent_posts.title: GameMaker incorporates Claude Code to enable vibe coding
recent_posts.summary: GameMaker has launched a new runtime (GMRT) and command line toolchain (GM-CLI) that integrates Claude Code by Anthropic, enabling AI-assisted 'vibe coding' workflows. Developers can use natural language prompts in the terminal to query project structures, hunt bugs, and manage build configurations — without needing the IDE open. The integration also supports GitHub Actions automation and an MCP Server. GameMaker head Russell Kay emphasized the tools are opt-in and complementary, designed to serve both beginners and professional studios who want AI assistance in their workflow.

recent_posts.title: GreedFall developer Spiders has been liquidated
recent_posts.summary: French game studio Spiders, developer of GreedFall and The Technomancer, has been liquidated following parent company Nacon's insolvency filing earlier this year. The studio, which employed over 90 people and developed its own Silk Engine, confirmed the closure on Facebook, stating the company no longer exists and all staff will cease work immediately. A planned DLC will still be released through Nacon. The closure follows Nacon's failure to repay a bond loan.

recent_posts.title: How Overwatch rebuilt player trust through continuous communication
recent_posts.summary: Overwatch game director Aaron Keller shared at GDC 2026 how Blizzard turned around the franchise after Overwatch 2 became the most negatively reviewed game on Steam in 2023. The key strategy was continuous, transparent over-communication with players — including detailed blog posts, Director's Take articles, and honest explanations of development decisions. Keller emphasized that consistency mattered more than perfect messaging, and that rebuilding player trust required treating communication as an ongoing relationship rather than a reactive PR exercise. The approach has yielded measurable results, with Steam reviews improving from overwhelmingly negative to mixed.
